newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold off lows, market awaits direction.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold off lows, market awaits direction.

text.p: Istanbul gold prices recovered from earlier lows on Tuesday while volume eased to 1,135 kilos from Monday's 1,925.
Demand shrank as prices rose and as traders awaited market direction, dealers said.
Gold closed at $322.05 an ounce and 1,560,000 lira per gram after $316.20 and 1,526,000 lira on Monday.
This followed a minor recovery in European markets.
The Turkish currency closed at 150,590 lira to the dollar, against 150,000 on Monday, as the dollar gained in world markets. The weaker lira boosted gold's rise in lira terms, dealers said.
Most of the day's trade -- 970 kilos -- took place in the morning session with 54.6 percent of total volume conducted in lira terms.
